title: FaceSwapper.ai review: free tools, privacy and alternatives
summary: FaceSwapper.ai review covering photo, video and multi-face swaps, current free access, file deletion claims, limitations, and alternatives.
body_markdown:
## Quick answer


**FaceSwapper.ai is worth considering for free, no-signup photo, video and multi-face swaps. Its clearest strength is broad browser toolkit without a current paid signup path. The main limitation is pricing is unavailable and new accounts cannot currently be created. Magic Hour is the stronger fit when you want image, GIF and video face swap inside a broader image, video and audio workspace.**


This vendor-authored review was checked against[FaceSwapper.ai official product and policy pages](https://faceswapper.ai/) on September 20, 2026. Magic Hour publishes this guide and is included as an alternative. It is a documentation review, not a retained cross-tool quality benchmark.


## What is FaceSwapper.ai?


FaceSwapper.ai is an AI face-swap product for replacing a face in an image or video. Broad browser toolkit without a current paid signup path. Use only media you own or have permission to edit, and obtain explicit consent from every identifiable person.


## What FaceSwapper.ai does well


Free, no-signup photo, video and multi-face swaps. Its workflow removes much of the manual masking and compositing required by conventional editing. That convenience does not prove every output is accurate: inspect eyes, teeth, hairlines, skin edges, occlusion, lighting and identity across the full clip.


## FaceSwapper.ai pricing and access


FaceSwapper’s official pricing page currently says pricing is unavailable and its sign-in page says new accounts can no longer be created. The public site still describes free, no-signup image, video and multiple-face swapping. Previous paid users can sign in, so verify the exact tool and export path before planning repeat work.


## Privacy, consent and commercial use


Its privacy policy says uploaded and generated files are purged every six hours, while the product page says files are deleted immediately after generation and download. Because those statements differ, treat six hours as the more conservative published retention claim.


A commercial-use label does not clear publicity, copyright, trademark or contractual rights. Keep written consent, source licenses and disclosure records. Never use face swap to impersonate, deceive, harass or create intimate imagery without consent.

## How to test FaceSwapper.ai fairly


Use one permitted portrait, one difficult side angle and one short motion clip. Keep resolution, duration and source files constant. Record attempts, processing time, charged credits, watermarks, export resolution and whether the output was usable without manual repair.


Reject outputs with identity drift, unstable jaw or hair boundaries, flicker, incorrect occlusion, changed expression, altered skin tone or artifacts around glasses and hands. Compare cost per accepted output rather than cost per generation.


## Verdict


FaceSwapper.ai has a defensible place for free, no-signup photo, video and multi-face swaps. Pricing is unavailable and new accounts cannot currently be created. Test one representative job and verify current policies before committing sensitive media or recurring production.
